name: @ci/capacitor-local-hub
description: Capacitor plugin for the on-device Local Hub: a loopback-only embedded HTTP server that will grow into a durable SQLite/SQLCipher outbox plus local llama.cpp inference and the same read endpoints CI-Server's memory domain exposes. This pass (Phase 1) is a skeleton -- start()/stop()/getStatus() and a single bearer-authenticated GET /api/health -- see README.md. Unlike @ci/capacitor-local-llm (Android-only), this plugin ships both Android and iOS native implementations.
